faction_profile.source: audit-added (CONTEXT_SUMMARY names Fire Solutions as the Refuge's forest-burners)
faction_profile.atlas_lore_note: Recovered from the Claude handoff context: Fire Solutions is the Refuge-linked forest-burner and fire-safety contractor faction that was missing from the generated faction set.

player_safe.name: Fire Solutions
player_safe.public_face: Heroic fire-safety crews who clear dangerous brush, sell fire wards, and are always, impressively, first on the scene.
player_safe.slogan: Fire Solutions™: ahead of the flames.
player_safe.short_description: Fire Solutions™ is a forest-safety contractor that clears hazardous undergrowth, sells fire wards, and arrives to save you from blazes with remarkable, suspicious speed.
player_safe.long_description: Fire Solutions™ rolls in like a parade of competence: orange-lacquered water-wagons, crews in flame-bright livery, a beaming foreman handing out free Ember Alarms™ and FireSafe Family™ pamphlets. Buy a Controlled-Burn Subscription™, a Defensible Perimeter™ package, a Rapid Response Retainer™ that guarantees a crew within the hour. They are genuinely fast, genuinely brave, and genuinely everywhere a fire happens to start. The brochure shows a saved village and a grateful child. The crews are heroes. It is just a remarkable coincidence how reliably the forest catches, and how reliably the people who could not afford the retainer are the ones who needed it.
player_safe.table_read_aloud: Orange wagons, crews in fire-bright livery, a cheerful foreman pressing a free Ember Alarm™ into your hands. 'Forest's been awful dry,' he says, smiling, already first on the scene of a fire nobody has reported yet.

block1.name: Fire Solutions
block1.public_face: Heroic fire-safety crews who clear dangerous brush, sell fire wards, and are always, impressively, first on the scene.
block1.what_they_really_do: Sell protection from a danger they quietly supply: burn the brush, then the woods, then the bill.
block1.place_in_story: The Refuge and the Fire Walk show the burned ground and the grateful survivors who now pay a retainer.
block1.disposition_to_pcs: Heroically friendly, proud of the rescues, and visibly uncomfortable if you ask who reported the fire.
block1.the_lever: Proof of where a fire started, a burn pattern that does not match an accident, or a survivor who saw the wagons arrive too early.

block2.standing: The frontier's trusted name in fire safety, first wagon to every blaze and first invoice after.
block2.what_they_control: Brush-clearing crews, fire wards, water-wagons, and the Refuge's burned-over perimeter.
block2.how_they_operate: Manufacture the emergency they answer: thin the forest, let it catch, arrive as heroes, and sell the retainer to everyone who just watched a neighbor burn.
block2.internal_tensions: Real firefighters who love the saving part work beside managers who schedule the 'controlled' burns; most crews do not know which fires were homework.
block2.current_moves: Running cheerful 'fire awareness' drives in the dry season while controlled burns creep closer to villages that have not yet subscribed.
block2.history_hook: Institutional beliefs: The Season We Saved Everyone (Who Paid); Brush Is Liability; A Grateful Village Renews.

rivals: Other brands in staged public competition
block3.who_they_prey_on: Forest villages and smallholders who cannot afford a retainer until they have already watched the tree line burn.

block4.slogan: Fire Solutions™: ahead of the flames.
block4.aesthetic: Fire-bright orange and ash-grey, water-wagon livery, soot-smudged but smiling, and a heroic mascot firefighter giving a thumbs-up over a saved cottage.
voice: Forest's been awful dry lately. Lucky we're close!
First on the scene, every time, that's the Fire Solutions promise!
Can't put a price on safety. So we put a retainer on it!
block4.logo_hook: Use the generated logo as the profile mark; show the heroic public rescue and the buried cause separately.
block4.theme_song_hook: Seed only for a future theme pass; do not generate music in this implementation.

block5.relevance_to_players: The Refuge's survivors and the Fire Walk's scorched ground are Fire Solutions' satisfied customers.
block5.relevance_to_world: Daily safety in the dry season depends on a brand that profits from the very fire it fights.
block5.secrets: Never player-facing on first contact: the 'controlled' burns are not always controlled, and not always accidental.
block5.hidden_ties: Deepest layer, GM-only: Board ownership sits behind this brand; the burns keep protection demand healthy, and the money flows up to Athervast.

progressive_disclosure.content: Fire Solutions looks like heroic fire safety: fast crews, free alarms, grateful villages.
They are always first, sometimes impossibly first, and the people who did not subscribe are the ones who burn.
They set what they fight; the peril is the product, routed to the Board.

earn_it_hooks: Knowledge 12 reads a burn pattern that started in cleared brush, not lightning.
Presence 13 gets a guilt-sick crew member to admit the 'controlled' burns are scheduled.
